title: Mixing: Bring On The Lucie (Freeda Peeple) by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The sixth of 17 mixing sessions for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 28 August 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. On this day the song ‘Bring On The Lucie (Freeda Peeple)’ was worked on, although the final mix was created on 12 September.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.
